profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer that is passionate about open source software/hardware. 

My Background is in  cloud applications and I enjoy all parts of the process from designing and developing to containerizing and deploying.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained and updated core cloud services
• Ported node.js services into rust
• Created streaming analytics UI
• Applied Docker best practices to cloud services
• Modified core cloud services to run on-premise
• Ensured the security and continuous integration of projects

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
• Guided and mentored a team of engineers
• Developed an integration test suite
• Developed the AngularJS application
• Created and implemented an automated new hire process
• Designed and developed core application services
• Managed, maintained, and deployed cloud micro services

positions.title: Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, and documented public client API
• Developed the application status page using a custom d3.js library
• Created Ansible playbooks to bootstrap virtual machines

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, documented, and published open source node.js module to npmjs.org
• Developed a message queue system for the application

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

• Implemented threaded UDP protocol.
• Fixed XML layout issues

• Live Event monitoring and enforcement
